sentences.en: We desperately need more money to help fund our project.
sentences.zh: 我们非常迫切地需要更多的钱来资助我们的项目。

sentences.en: "I can't go through the Haunted Wood," cried Anne desperately.
sentences.zh: ‘我不能穿过幽灵森林。’安妮绝望地喊道。

sentences.en: He's desperately trying to make up for the delay.
sentences.zh: 他正不顾一切地试图弥补延误的时间。

senses.zh: 绝望地；不顾一切地，拼命地极度地；猛烈地
